headline: Renaissance Global allots 40,000 securities under ESOP
hook: Small ESOP allotment at Renaissance Global
summary: Renaissance Global Limited announced the allotment of 40,000 securities pursuant to its employee stock option or purchase scheme. The decision was approved during a company meeting held on October 16, 2026. This routine filing reflects standard employee stock compensation activity. Such minor equity expansions have negligible impact on retail shareholder value.
why_it_matters: Minimal equity dilution for existing shareholders.
